title: cosmos show
description: A show folder's settings: which template set, what runs with no timeline, the pause policy, per-source latency.

kind.description: "klights.show" -- it says which format the file is

template_set.description: the id of a file in templates/

fallback.description: what runs when a track has no timeline, no phrases and no grid: today's auto mode, or nothing but the operator

policy.description: idle: hand over to idle_routine after grace_s. freeze: hold still. continue: keep moving at the last tempo

grace_s.description: seconds of silence before a deck counts as paused

idle_routine.description: the id of a file in routines/

default.description: disarmed: the DJ feed shows but drives nothing until someone arms it

version.description: Format version. Current is 1; a file with no version is treated as 1.
